author: Moonlight_0315
quote: This game took 8 years of development, it was delayed twice to apparently fix bugs, on a 500 USD console and the game itself is 80-100 USD. You get all this for a buggy mess with no story and a community full of misogynistic little boys who can't even handle a virtual relationship with someone who isn't even real. Rockstar games have never interested me except for RD but this one is just the bottom of the barrel and it's community is so toxic that they can't even tolerate another game being rated higher.

author: Moonlight_0315
quote: This game stayed true to the original but with added upgrades. They remade the music and remodeled the characters and this is actually one of the very few Zelda games that has voice acting! I was very excited to learn that the characters would be fully voice acted in cutscenes. The game is mostly the same with a few quality of life changes and the puzzles and enemies do seem a bit easier but it is a good change since this game attracted new players to the franchise. I did a playthrough of the game with one of my friends and we both loved it. I also really like that the game isn't too hard to understand and is easily playable and able to be played by all ages. The story is the same but it is just as good as it was in the original game and the puzzles were fun to solve as well and were engaging, I'd prefer games that are engaging and make you use your mind over games with boring gameplay like GTA 6.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Moonlight_0315
quote: This game is always regarded as the best Zelda game and I can see why, it changed the way 3d games work entirely and became an inspiration in the gaming world. The story is great and I love that there's puzzles to work out and it's not just mindless gameplay like GTA 6. The characters are also likeable and each has their own story and personality. The music is also great.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
